why.ar: لا يبدأ التقادم إلا من اليوم الذي يصبح فيه الدين مستحق الأداء، ولا يذكر النص تاريخ العقد. وقرأت حالة حدية (عقد أبرم قبل خمسة أشهر) أن الاستحقاق لا يسبق العقد فلا يمكن أن تكون المدة قد انقضت، بينما يسأل السجل عن تاريخ الاستحقاق لأن العقد قد يثبت دينا أقدم منه. ويبقى السؤال مفتوحا بقرار المالك.
why.en: Civil-code 315 ¶1 starts limitation only on the day the debt becomes due, and says nothing of the contract date. A boundary case (bc16, a contract made five months before) reads that the due date cannot precede the contract, so the period cannot have run; the record asks for the due date, since a contract may record a debt older than itself. Kept open on the owner's instruction (verifier, follow-up 1).

reading.ar: يبدأ التقادم من تاريخ الاستحقاق، ويسأل عنه المحامي ولو كان العقد حديثا.
reading.en: Limitation starts on the due date, which the lawyer is asked for even when the contract is recent.

reading.ar: لا يسبق الاستحقاق العقد المنشئ للالتزام، فتعد الدعوى في أجلها متى كان العقد أحدث من المدة.
reading.en: The due date cannot precede the contract that created the obligation, so the claim is in time whenever the contract is more recent than the period.

protectiveReading.ar: السؤال عن تاريخ الاستحقاق وعدم الحكم بأن الدعوى في أجلها قبل معرفته؛ وبعد إدخاله يحسب الأجل وينبه قرب آخر يوم منه.
protectiveReading.en: Ask for the due date and do not report the claim in time before it is known; once it is given, the deadline is counted and warns near its last day.

question.ar: هل تقوم عريضة افتتاح الدعوى أو تبليغها الرسمي مقام الإنذار؟
question.en: Does the statement of claim, or its official service, stand in the place of the warning?

why.ar: المادة 180 تجيز ما يقوم مقام الإنذار دون تعداده، ولا نص في المخزن على العريضة. وقرار المحكمة العليا 1009298 (موقع المحكمة) يعطي قراءة مشروطة للالتزامات المتتالية، وهو اجتهاد لا نص في المخزن.
why.en: Article 180 allows an act that stands in the place of a warning without listing such acts, and no text in the store speaks of the petition. The Supreme Court's decision 1009298 (court website) gives a conditional reading for successive obligations; it is case law, not a text of the store.

reading.ar: العريضة المبلغة رسميا تقوم مقام الإنذار.
reading.en: The officially served petition stands in the place of the warning.

reading.ar: يجب إعذار سابق مستقل عن الدعوى.
reading.en: A separate notice before the claim is required.

reading.ar: قراءة المحكمة العليا (القرار 1009298 المؤرخ في 10-09-2015، الغرفة التجارية والبحرية): الإعذار غير لازم مبدئيا في الالتزامات المتتالية أو المستمرة إلا إعذارا واحدا عند الامتناع عن أول التزام منها، فإذا توفر ذلك تكون الدعوى المرفوعة بمثابة الإعذار؛ ولا تقوم الدعوى مقام الإعذار الذي اشترطه العقد.
reading.en: The Supreme Court's reading (decision 1009298 of 10-09-2015, commercial and maritime chamber): notice is in principle not needed for successive or continuing obligations, except one notice at the failure to perform the first of them; once that is met, the lawsuit stands as the notice; the lawsuit does not replace a notice the contract requires.

protectiveReading.ar: اعتبار الإعذار السابق مطلوبا والتنبيه إلى غيابه دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Treat a prior notice as required and warn of its absence; do not block the export.

question.ar: ما هو الوجه المبين في القانون للإعذار بالبريد، وهل تكفي الرسالة المضمونة مع الإشعار بالاستلام؟
question.en: What is the postal way the code refers to, and does a registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt suffice?

why.ar: المادة 180 تحيل إلى وجه مبين في القانون، ولم يوجد في المخزن نص يبينه.
why.en: Article 180 refers to a way set out in the code; no text in the store sets it out.

reading.ar: الرسالة المضمونة مع الإشعار بالاستلام تكفي.
reading.en: A registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt suffices.

reading.ar: لا يكفي البريد إلا في الشكل الذي يحدده نص لم يعثر عليه.
reading.en: Post suffices only in a form set by a text not found.

protectiveReading.ar: قبول الرسالة المضمونة مع الاحتفاظ بإشعار الاستلام والتحقق من الشكل، وتفضيل الإنذار بمحضر قضائي.
protectiveReading.en: Accept a registered letter, keep the acknowledgement of receipt and check its form; a bailiff's warning is the safer means.

question.ar: هل يشترط الإعذار للتعويض عن التأخر في دفع مبلغ نقدي، ومن أي تاريخ يحسب؟
question.en: Is notice required for damages for late payment of a sum of money, and from what date do they run?

why.ar: المادة 186 تذكر مبلغا معينا وقت رفع الدعوى ولا تذكر الإعذار، والمادة 179 عامة.
why.en: Article 186 speaks of a sum fixed when the claim is filed and does not mention notice; article 179 is general.

reading.ar: يشترط الإعذار وفق المادة 179، ويحسب التعويض من الإعذار.
reading.en: Notice is required under article 179, and damages run from the notice.

reading.ar: المادة 186 نص خاص يغني عن الإعذار ويحسب من رفع الدعوى.
reading.en: Article 186 is a special text that replaces notice, running from the claim.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه إلى الإعذار عند طلب التعويض، وذكر تاريخ الإعذار وتاريخ رفع الدعوى.
protectiveReading.en: Warn about notice whenever damages are asked, and state both the notice date and the filing date.

question.ar: ما جزاء غياب الإعذار: عدم القبول، أم رفض الطلب موضوعا، أم عدم استحقاق التعويض فقط؛ وهل يثيره القاضي تلقائيا؟
question.en: What does the lack of notice cost: inadmissibility, rejection on the merits, or only that damages are not due; and does the judge raise it of his own motion?

why.ar: المادة 179 تقول إن التعويض لا يستحق، والمادة 119 لا تذكر جزاء، ولا نص في المخزن على من يثيره.
why.en: Article 179 says compensation is not due, article 119 states no sanction, and no text in the store says who raises it.

reading.ar: يرفض طلب التعويض أو الفسخ لعدم الإعذار.
reading.en: The request for damages or rescission is rejected for lack of notice.

reading.ar: لا تقبل الدعوى.
reading.en: The claim is inadmissible.

reading.ar: لا يمس الطلب إلا في التعويض عن المدة السابقة على الإعذار.
reading.en: Only damages for the period before notice are lost.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Warn; do not block the export.

question.ar: ما الوسائل التي تقوم مقام الإنذار، ومن يقدر ذلك؟
question.en: Which means stand in the place of a warning, and who judges it?

why.ar: المادة 180 تذكر ما يقوم مقام الإنذار دون تعداده، فلا يحسم النص هل تكفي مكالمة أو رسالة إلكترونية أو محضر عدم مصالحة.
why.en: Article 180 names an act that stands in the place of a warning without listing such acts, so the text does not settle whether a call, an e-mail or a record of non-conciliation suffices.

reading.ar: يقدر المحامي هل الوسيلة تقوم مقام الإنذار، ويسكت التطبيق إن قال نعم.
reading.en: The lawyer judges whether the means stands in the place of a warning, and the app is silent once he says it does.

reading.ar: كل وسيلة غير الإنذار بمحضر قضائي أو البريد يجب التنبيه إليها لأن النص لا يحدد ما يقوم مقام الإنذار.
reading.en: Every means other than a bailiff's warning or the post is flagged, because the text does not say what stands in the place of a warning.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه دائما عند استعمال وسيلة أخرى.
protectiveReading.en: Always warn when another means was used.

question.ar: هل يكفي إعذار بلغ في يوم رفع الدعوى أو بعده؟
question.en: Does a notice served on the day of the petition, or after it, suffice?

why.ar: المادة 119 تجعل المطالبة بعد الإعذار، والمادة 179 تجعل استحقاق التعويض بعده دون ذكر رفع الدعوى؛ ولا يقارن التطبيق تاريخ الإعذار بتاريخ العريضة، فيسأل المحامي هل بلغ الإعذار قبل يوم العريضة (n12)، ولا تعد الخطوات p1 وp2 وp3 الإعذار منجزا إلا إذا كان الجواب نعم. وفي دعوى التعويض وحدها مع إعذار بلغ بعد العريضة، لا يحسم أي من النصين المسألة، فتبقى القراءتان وينبه التطبيق دون أن يمنع.
why.en: Article 119 puts the claim after the notice; article 179 puts the entitlement to compensation after it, without mentioning the filing. The app does not compare the notice date with the petition date, so it asks the lawyer whether the notice was served before the petition's day (n12); the steps p1, p2 and p3 count the notice as done only when the answer is yes. For a claim for damages alone with a notice served after the petition, neither text settles it, so both readings stay and the app warns, never blocks.

reading.ar: يجب أن يسبق الإعذار رفع الدعوى، ولو اقتصرت على طلب التعويض، لأن التعويض لا يستحق إلا بعد الإعذار.
reading.en: The notice must precede the filing, even for a claim for damages alone, since compensation is due only after notice.

reading.ar: يكفي في التعويض أن يقع الإعذار قبل الحكم.
reading.en: For damages, a notice before the judgment suffices.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه عند إعذار بلغ في يوم العريضة أو بعده، والسؤال عن ذلك عند جهله (n12)؛ والرسائل والوثيقة الأولى تطلب التحقق من أن تاريخ الإعذار سابق على العريضة.
protectiveReading.en: Warn when the notice was served on the petition's day or after it, and ask when that is not known (n12); the messages and the first document ask to check that the notice date precedes the petition.

question.ar: هل المادة 502 نص مخالف يغني عن الإعذار في التعويض عن شغل العين بعد انتهاء الإيجار؟
question.en: Is article 502 a contrary text that makes the compensation for holding over due without notice?

why.ar: المادة 179 تستثني ما يوجد فيه نص مخالف، والمادة 502 تلزم المستأجر الذي يبقي العين دون حق بالتعويض دون أن تذكر الإعذار؛ وسكوت النص لا يحسم أنه نص مخالف.
why.en: Article 179 yields to a contrary text, and article 502 makes a tenant who keeps the property without right pay compensation without mentioning notice; the silence does not settle that it is a contrary text.

reading.ar: المادة 502 تجعل التعويض مستحقا بمجرد البقاء دون حق بعد انتهاء الإيجار.
reading.en: Article 502 makes the compensation due from the mere holding over after the lease ends.

reading.ar: تبقى المادة 179 سارية: لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد الإعذار.
reading.en: Article 179 still applies: the compensation is due only after notice.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه إلى الإعذار عند طلب التعويض، مع ذكر هذه القراءة.
protectiveReading.en: Warn about the notice when damages are asked, and mention this reading.

question.ar: هل المادة 14 من الأمر 95-07 نص مخالف يغني عن الإعذار في فوائد التأخر عن دفع تعويض التأمين؟
question.en: Is article 14 of ordinance 95-07 a contrary text that dispenses with notice for interest on a late insurance indemnity?

why.ar: القانون 06-04 (الجريدة الرسمية 2006، العدد 15، ص 3)، المادة 3 المعدلة للمادة 14: «إذا لم يدفع التعويض ... في الآجال المحددة في الشروط العامة لعقد التأمين، يحق للمستفيد طلب هذا التعويض بإضافة الفوائد عن كل يوم تأخير، على نسبة إعادة الخصم». النص لا يذكر الإعذار، وهو غير موجود في المخزن وطلب.
why.en: Law 06-04 (Official Journal 2006, issue 15, p. 3), article 3 rewriting article 14: when the indemnity is not paid within the periods of the general conditions, the beneficiary may claim it with interest for each day of delay at the rediscount rate. The text does not mention notice; it is not in the store and was requested.

reading.ar: الفوائد تسري من انقضاء أجل التسوية دون إعذار.
reading.en: Interest runs from the end of the settlement period without notice.

reading.ar: تبقى المادة 179 سارية.
reading.en: Article 179 still applies.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه إلى الإعذار عند طلب التعويض، مع ذكر هذه القراءة.
protectiveReading.en: Warn about the notice when damages are asked, and mention this reading.

question.ar: هل يعد التصريح الإلكتروني (بريد إلكتروني، رسالة نصية) تصريحا كتابيا بعدم التنفيذ يغني عن الإعذار؟
question.en: Does an electronic statement (e-mail, text message) count as a written declaration of non-performance that dispenses with notice?

why.ar: المادة 181 تقول «صرح المدين كتابة» دون تعريف الكتابة؛ المادتان 323 مكرر و323 مكرر 1 تسويان الكتابة الإلكترونية بالورقية في الإثبات بشروط، وتطبيقهما على المادة 181 قراءة.
why.en: Article 181 says «صرح المدين كتابة» without defining writing; articles 323 مكرر and 323 مكرر 1 treat electronic writing as paper writing for proof, under conditions, and applying them to article 181 is a reading.

reading.ar: التصريح الإلكتروني الذي يمكن التأكد من صاحبه وسلامته كتابة.
reading.en: An electronic statement whose author and integrity can be checked is writing.

reading.ar: لا يعتد إلا بالمحرر الورقي.
reading.en: Only a paper writing counts.

protectiveReading.ar: يقدر المحامي، ويحتفظ بالرسالة الإلكترونية وما يثبت مصدرها؛ الإعذار يبقى أسلم.
protectiveReading.en: The lawyer judges; keep the electronic message and proof of its source; a notice remains the safer course.

question.ar: متى تسري قواعد الاختصاص الجديدة للمحاكم الإدارية والمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة؟
question.en: From when do the new jurisdiction rules of the administrative and specialised commercial courts apply?

why.ar: تربط المادة 13 من القانون 22-13 السريان بتنصيب الجهات الجديدة، ولا يتضمن المخزن تاريخ التنصيب ولا نص التنصيب.
why.en: Article 13 of law 22-13 ties application to the installation of the new courts, and the store holds neither the installation date nor the installing text.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه إلى المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة وسؤال المحامي عن تنصيبها، دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: Warn about the specialised commercial court and ask the lawyer whether it is installed; never block.

reading.ar: تسري القواعد في كل دائرة من تاريخ تنصيب محكمتها.
reading.en: The rules run in each area from the installation of its court.

reading.ar: تبقى الدعاوى المرفوعة قبل التنصيب للجهات السابقة.
reading.en: Cases filed before the installation stay with the former courts.

question.ar: هل تعد دعوى ضد صاحب عمل في حالة إفلاس أو تسوية قضائية من منازعات الإفلاس التي تختص بها المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة، وهل يجب التصريح بالدين في الإجراء الجماعي؟
question.en: Is a claim against an employer in bankruptcy or judicial settlement a bankruptcy dispute for the specialised commercial court, and must the debt first be declared in the collective procedure?

why.ar: المادة 536 مكرر تذكر التسوية القضائية والإفلاس دون تحديد، ونصوص الإفلاس في القانون التجاري ليست في المخزن؛ ما يعرف عنها من الذاكرة فقط.
why.en: Article 536 مكرر names judicial settlement and bankruptcy without more, and the Commercial Code's bankruptcy texts are not in the store; what is believed about them comes from memory only.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه ودعوة المحامي إلى التحقق، دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: Warn and ask the lawyer to check; never block.

question.ar: ما قواعد الادعاء المدني أمام القاضي الجزائي، وحجية اختيار الطريق، وإرجاء الفصل في الدعوى المدنية؟
question.en: What are the rules on the civil action before the criminal judge, the binding choice of route, and the stay of the civil action?

why.ar: هذه القواعد في قانون الإجراءات الجزائية الساري، وهو القانون 25-14 المؤرخ في 3 غشت 2025 (الجريدة الرسمية 2025 العدد 54) الذي ألغى الأمر 66-155؛ نصه غير موجود في المخزن، وطلب إضافته؛ ولم يرد في المخزن إلا المادة 339 من القانون المدني وإرجاء مضاهاة الخطوط في المادة 165.
why.en: These rules are in the Code of Criminal Procedure in force, law 25-14 of 3 August 2025 (Official Journal 2025 no. 54), which repealed ordinance 66-155; its text is not in the store and has been requested; only civil-code 339 and the handwriting stay of cpca 165 are in it.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه عند وجود متابعة جزائية أو ضرر ناتج عن جريمة، ودعوة المحامي إلى التحقق، دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: Warn when there is a criminal case or damage from an offence, and ask the lawyer to check; never block.

reading.ar: من الجريدة الرسمية، لم يقرأ في المخزن بعد: تجوز مباشرة الدعوى المدنية مع الدعوى العمومية أمام الجهة القضائية الجزائية أو منفصلة عنها، ومن باشرها أمام الجهة المدنية لا يرفعها أمام الجهة الجزائية إلا إذا حركت النيابة الدعوى العمومية قبل الحكم في الموضوع، وعليه عندئذ التنازل عن دعواه المدنية (المواد 4 و5 و6).
reading.en: From the Official Journal, not yet read in the store: the civil action may be brought with the public action before the criminal court or separately; one who brought it before the civil court cannot take it to the criminal court unless the prosecution started before a judgment on the merits, and must then withdraw the civil claim (arts. 4, 5 and 6).

reading.ar: من الجريدة الرسمية، لم يقرأ في المخزن بعد: ترجئ الجهة القضائية المدنية الحكم إلى حين الفصل نهائيا في الدعوى العمومية إذا كانت قد حركت (المادة 5)، وتتقادم الدعوى المدنية وفق القانون المدني ولا ترفع أمام الجهة الجزائية بعد تقادم الدعوى العمومية (المادة 17).
reading.en: From the Official Journal, not yet read in the store: the civil court defers judgment until the public action, if set in motion, is finally decided (art. 5); the civil action is time-barred under the civil code and cannot be brought before the criminal court once the public action is time-barred (art. 17).

question.ar: هل المادة 804 تحدد النوع أم المكان فقط، وهل يخرج نزاع الموظف عن المحاكم العادية إذا لم يكن الطرف الآخر من أشخاص المادة 800؟
question.en: Does article 804 fix the subject matter or only the place, and does a civil servant's dispute leave the ordinary courts when the other party is not one of the persons of article 800?

why.ar: المادة 804 واردة في قسم الاختصاص الإقليمي، لكنها تذكر ما يرفع وجوبا أمام المحاكم الإدارية، والمادة 3 من قانون علاقات العمل تخرج الموظفين من نطاقه.
why.en: Article 804 sits in the section on territorial jurisdiction but says which actions must be brought before the administrative courts, and article 3 of the labour relations law takes civil servants out of its scope.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه عند كون المدعي موظفا، دون منع، وعرض المادة 804 كقاعدة مكانية.
protectiveReading.en: Warn when the plaintiff is a civil servant, never block, and show article 804 as a venue rule.

reading.ar: منازعة الموظف منازعة إدارية تختص بها المحكمة الإدارية ولو لم يكن الطرف الآخر من الأشخاص المذكورين في المادة 800.
reading.en: A civil servant's dispute is an administrative dispute for the administrative court even when the other party is not one of the persons named in article 800.

reading.ar: لا يخرج النزاع عن المحاكم العادية إلا إذا كان أحد الأطراف من الأشخاص المذكورين في المادة 800، والمادة 804 قاعدة إقليمية فقط.
reading.en: The dispute leaves the ordinary courts only when one of the persons named in article 800 is a party; article 804 is only a venue rule.

question.ar: ما دوائر الاختصاص الإقليمي للمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة، وما حكم دائرة لم تنصب محكمتها بعد؟
question.en: What are the areas of the specialised commercial courts, and what governs an area whose own court is not yet installed?

why.ar: المرسوم التنفيذي 23-53 (الجريدة الرسمية 2023 العدد 2، ص 18-19) والمرسوم التنفيذي 26-133 المعدل له (الجريدة الرسمية 2026 العدد 27، ص 10-11) يحددان خمسا وعشرين محكمة ودوائرها بالمجالس القضائية، ويمدان اختصاص المحاكم المنصبة إلى دوائر المحاكم الجديدة إلى حين تنصيبها؛ وهما غير موجودين في المخزن وطلبت إضافتهما.
why.en: Executive decree 23-53 (Official Journal 2023 no. 2, pp. 18-19) and executive decree 26-133 amending it (Official Journal 2026 no. 27, pp. 10-11) fix twenty-five courts and their areas by judicial council, and extend the jurisdiction of installed courts over the areas of new courts until those are installed; neither is in the store, and both have been requested.

reading.ar: يمتد اختصاص المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة المنصبة إلى دائرة المحكمة الجديدة إلى حين تنصيبها، فلا تعود المنازعة إلى القسم التجاري.
reading.en: The jurisdiction of the installed specialised commercial court extends over the new court's area until it is installed, so the dispute does not return to the commercial section.

reading.ar: لا تسري قواعد الاختصاص الجديدة في دائرة إلا من تاريخ تنصيب محكمتها.
reading.en: The new jurisdiction rules run in an area only from the installation of its own court.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه إلى المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة كلما اندرج النزاع في موادها، ودعوة المحامي إلى التحقق من المحكمة المختصة إقليميا.
protectiveReading.en: Warn about the specialised commercial court whenever the dispute is one of its matters, and ask the lawyer to check the court competent for the area.

question.ar: هل يؤدي رفع الدعوى أمام قسم غير مختص إلى عدم القبول أو عدم الاختصاص النوعي، أم يعالج بالإحالة فقط؟
question.en: Does filing before the wrong section lead to inadmissibility or to a lack of subject-matter jurisdiction, or only to a referral?

why.ar: المادة 32 تنص على الإحالة الداخلية عن طريق أمانة الضبط ولا تذكر عدم القبول، والمادة 36 تجعل عدم الاختصاص النوعي من النظام العام، ولا نص يقول صراحة إن توزيع القضايا على الأقسام مسألة اختصاص نوعي.
why.en: Article 32 provides an internal referral through the registry and mentions no inadmissibility; article 36 makes lack of subject-matter jurisdiction a public-order matter; no text says expressly whether the split between sections is a question of subject-matter jurisdiction.

reading.ar: توزيع القضايا على الأقسام تنظيم داخلي، ويعالج الخطأ بالإحالة دون رفض الدعوى.
reading.en: The split between sections is internal organisation; an error is cured by referral, not by dismissing the claim.

reading.ar: قاعدة اختصاص من النظام العام تثار تلقائيا إذا لم تتم الإحالة.
reading.en: A rule of jurisdiction of public order, raised of the court's own motion if no referral is made.

protectiveReading.ar: اقتراح القسم الملائم والتنبيه عند اختلافه عن اختيار المحامي، دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Propose the fitting section and warn when the lawyer's choice differs; never block the export.

question.ar: أي قسم ينظر في دعوى تجمع طلبات من طبائع مختلفة؟
question.en: Which section hears a claim that joins requests of different natures?

why.ar: المادة 32 تربط الجدولة بطبيعة النزاع ولا تبين حكم الطلبات المختلطة، والنص الوحيد على الطلبات الإضافية يخص القسم الاجتماعي.
why.en: Article 32 ties listing to the nature of the dispute and says nothing of mixed requests; the only text on additional requests concerns the social section.

reading.ar: يحدد الطلب الأصلي القسم، وتتبعه الطلبات التابعة.
reading.en: The principal request decides the section; accessory requests follow it.

protectiveReading.ar: اقتراح القسم وفق الطلب الأصلي مع التنبيه عند الاختلاف.
protectiveReading.en: Propose the section of the principal request and warn when the choice differs.

question.ar: متى نصبت المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة، وفي أي مقرات ودوائر؟
question.en: When, and with which seats and areas, were the specialised commercial courts installed?

why.ar: القانون 22-13 يؤجل سريان قواعد الاختصاص الجديدة إلى تاريخ التنصيب ويبقي للأقسام التجارية الدعاوى المرفوعة قبله. وجد المدقق في الجريدة الرسمية المرسوم التنفيذي 23-53 (العدد 2 لسنة 2023، ص 18-19) الذي حدد اثنتي عشرة محكمة تجارية متخصصة عبر كامل التراب الوطني ودوائر اختصاصها بالمجالس القضائية، والمرسوم التنفيذي 26-133 (العدد 27 لسنة 2026، ص 10-11) الذي رفع عددها إلى خمس وعشرين، ونص على تنصيب الجديدة تدريجيا، ومد اختصاص المحاكم المنصبة قبل صدوره إلى دوائر الجديدة إلى حين تنصيبها، وأبقى الإجراءات القائمة أمام المحاكم المختصة قبله. لم يوجد نص رسمي يحدد تاريخ تنصيب كل محكمة، والمرسومان ليسا بعد في مخزن النصوص.
why.en: Law 22-13 defers the new jurisdiction rules to the installation date and keeps earlier-filed cases with the commercial sections. The verifier found in the Official Journal Executive Decree 23-53 (JO 2023 no. 2, pp. 18-19), which set twelve specialised commercial courts across the whole national territory with their areas by judicial council, and Executive Decree 26-133 (JO 2026 no. 27, pp. 10-11), which raised them to twenty-five, has the new ones installed gradually, extends the courts installed before it to the new courts' areas until those are installed, and keeps pending proceedings where they are. No official text found gives each court's installation date, and neither decree is in the article store yet.

reading.ar: قبل التنصيب يبقى القسم التجاري مختصا بكل المنازعات التجارية، وبعده تبقى له الدعاوى المرفوعة أمامه قبل التنصيب فقط.
reading.en: Before installation the commercial section keeps all commercial disputes; afterwards it keeps only the cases filed before it before installation.

reading.ar: لعريضة ترفع الآن تخرج منازعات المادة 536 مكرر من القسم التجاري إلى المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة التي تشمل دائرتها المجلس القضائي المعني، لأن المرسومين يغطيان كامل التراب الوطني ويفترضان محاكم منصبة.
reading.en: For a petition filed now, the disputes of article 536 bis leave the commercial section for the specialised commercial court whose area covers the judicial council concerned, because the two decrees cover the whole national territory and presuppose installed courts.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه في كل نزاع من منازعات المادة 536 مكرر، وطلب التحقق من المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة المختصة بالمجلس القضائي المعني ومن محضر عدم الصلح، دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Warn in every dispute of article 536 bis and ask the lawyer to check which specialised commercial court covers the judicial council concerned, and the record of non-conciliation; never block.

question.ar: ما القسم الاحتياطي في محكمة أنشئت فيها الأقسام، وهل يتبع طلب السكن وطلب القسمة القسمين المقترحين؟
question.en: Which section is the residual one in a court that has sections, and do housing and partition requests belong to the sections proposed?

why.ar: لا نص يسمي قسما احتياطيا؛ وطلب السكن قد يكون من توابع انحلال الزواج أو نزاعا إيجاريا، والقسمة قد تتعلق بمنقولات أو بتركة.
why.en: No text names a residual section; a housing request may be a consequence of divorce or a lease dispute, and a partition may concern movables or an estate.

reading.ar: القسم المدني احتياطي، والسكن من توابع انحلال الزواج، والقسمة من صلاحيات القسم العقاري.
reading.en: The civil section is residual; housing is a consequence of divorce; partition belongs to the real-estate section.

reading.ar: لا يقترح قسم، ويكتفى بتنبيه المحامي إلى التحقق من القسم (قراءة الاشتقاق ب).
reading.en: Propose no section and only warn the lawyer to check it (derivation B's reading).

protectiveReading.ar: اقتراح القسم مع التنبيه عند اختلاف اختيار المحامي.
protectiveReading.en: Propose a section and warn when the lawyer's choice differs.

question.ar: هل تشمل الفقرة الخامسة من المادة 32 المحكمة التي لم ينشأ فيها القسم المعني وحده، وأي جهة تنظر في القضايا الاجتماعية في محكمة لم تنشأ فيها الأقسام؟
question.en: Does the fifth paragraph of article 32 cover a court that lacks only the section concerned, and who hears social cases in a court where the sections have not been created?

why.ar: النص يقول «المحاكم التي لم تنشأ فيها الأقسام» دون أن يبين هل المقصود كل الأقسام أو القسم المعني، ويبقي القسم المدني مختصا بكل شيء عدا القضايا الاجتماعية دون أن يسمي الجهة البديلة.
why.en: The text says 'courts where the sections have not been created' without saying whether all sections or the section concerned is meant, and it leaves the civil section with everything except social cases without naming a substitute.

reading.ar: تطبق الفقرة متى لم ينشأ القسم المعني بالنزاع.
reading.en: The paragraph applies whenever the section concerned has not been created.

reading.ar: تطبق الفقرة فقط في محكمة لم تنشأ فيها أقسام أصلا.
reading.en: The paragraph applies only in a court with no sections at all.

reading.ar: في محكمة قلص رئيسها عدد الأقسام بأمر، القسم المعني هو الذي يسنده إليه الأمر، ولا تحسم المادة 32 ذلك (المادة 21 من القانون العضوي للتنظيم القضائي، نص غير موجود في المخزن، النقطة o6).
reading.en: In a court whose president has reduced the number of sections by order, the section concerned is the one the order assigns, which article 32 does not settle (article 21 of the organic law on judicial organisation, a text not in the store; open point o6).

protectiveReading.ar: السؤال عن القسم المعني بالنزاع، واقتراح القسم المدني لغير القضايا الاجتماعية، والتنبيه في القضايا الاجتماعية إلى التحقق من القسم الذي تحدده المحكمة.
protectiveReading.en: Ask about the section concerned, propose the civil section for non-social cases, and warn in social cases to check which section the court assigns.

question.ar: ما أثر رفع الدعوى أمام قسم غير مختص على آجال السقوط والتقادم؟
question.en: What is the effect of filing before the wrong section on forfeiture and limitation periods?

why.ar: نص انقطاع التقادم يتناول المحكمة غير المختصة ولا يتناول القسم، ولا نص في المخزن عن أثر ذلك في آجال السقوط.
why.en: The interruption text speaks of a court without jurisdiction, not of a section; no text in the store addresses forfeiture periods in this case.

protectiveReading.ar: عدم الاعتماد على الدعوى الخاطئة لاحترام الأجل، وتحذير المحامي.
protectiveReading.en: Do not rely on a wrongly listed case to keep a period; warn the lawyer.

question.ar: هل يغطي السؤال عن الجهة العمومية كل الأطراف التي تدخل بها القضية في اختصاص المحاكم الإدارية؟
question.en: Does the slot on a public body cover every party that brings a case into the administrative courts?

why.ar: الصيغة المعدلة للمادة 800 تذكر أيضا الهيئات العمومية الوطنية والمنظمات المهنية الوطنية، والسؤال الحالي لا يذكرها، وتسري الصيغة المعدلة من تنصيب الجهات القضائية الإدارية الجديدة.
why.en: The amended wording of article 800 also names national public institutions and national professional organisations, which the slot's question does not; the amended wording applies from the installation of the new administrative courts.

protectiveReading.ar: سؤال مستقل عن الهيئات العمومية الوطنية والمنظمات المهنية الوطنية، ومخرج يحذر عند الإجابة بنعم ويذكر أن الصيغة المعدلة تسري من التنصيب.
protectiveReading.en: A separate question on national public institutions and national professional organisations, and an exit that warns when the answer is yes and says the amended wording runs from installation.

question.ar: هل ينظر القسم الاجتماعي في نزاع موظف أو عون خاضع للقانون الأساسي للمؤسسات والإدارات العمومية؟
question.en: Does the social section hear the dispute of a civil servant or an agent under the statute of public institutions and administrations?

why.ar: المادة 500 تتناول عقود العمل والتكوين والتمهين، والمادة 800 تسند للمحاكم الإدارية جميع القضايا التي تكون الدولة أو الولاية أو البلدية أو مؤسسة عمومية ذات صبغة إدارية طرفا فيها، والمادة 3 من قانون علاقات العمل تخرج الموظفين والأعوان المتعاقدين في الهيئات والإدارات العمومية ومستخدمي المؤسسات العمومية الإدارية من ذلك القانون إلى أحكام خاصة؛ فالنصوص ترجح القراءة الأولى، والقانون الأساسي للوظيفة العمومية ليس في المخزن، ولا يتناول النص مستخدمي المؤسسات العمومية ذات الطابع الصناعي والتجاري.
why.en: Article 500 covers employment, training and apprenticeship contracts; article 800 gives the administrative courts every case in which the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body is a party; labour-relations article 3 takes civil servants, contract agents of public bodies and administrations and staff of public administrative establishments out of that law and puts them under special provisions. The texts favour the first reading; the civil-service statute is not in the store, and article 3 does not name the staff of public industrial and commercial establishments.

reading.ar: النزاع خارج القسم الاجتماعي ومن اختصاص المحكمة الإدارية متى كان المستخدم من أشخاص المادة 800.
reading.en: The dispute leaves the social section and goes to the administrative court when the employer is one of the bodies of article 800.

reading.ar: يبقى النزاع للقسم الاجتماعي متى تعلق بعلاقة عمل.
reading.en: The dispute stays with the social section when it concerns an employment relationship.

protectiveReading.ar: عدم اقتراح القسم الاجتماعي لنزاع الموظف أو العون المتعاقد العمومي، والتنبيه دون منع، وطلب التحقق من الجهة المختصة.
protectiveReading.en: Do not propose the social section for the dispute of a civil servant or public contract agent; warn without blocking and ask the lawyer to check the competent court.

question.ar: أي جهة تنظر في دعوى أجر ضد صاحب عمل في حالة إفلاس أو تسوية قضائية: القسم الاجتماعي أم المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة؟
question.en: Who hears a wage claim against an employer in bankruptcy or judicial settlement: the social section or the specialised commercial court?

why.ar: المادة 500 تجعل منازعات تنفيذ عقود العمل للقسم الاجتماعي اختصاصا مانعا، والمادة 536 مكرر تسند التسوية القضائية والإفلاس للمحكمة التجارية المتخصصة، ولا نص يبين أيهما يحكم دعوى الأجر.
why.en: Article 500 gives the social section exclusive jurisdiction over the performance of employment contracts, article 536 bis gives judicial settlement and bankruptcy to the specialised commercial court, and no text says which governs the wage claim.

reading.ar: القسم الاجتماعي، لأن اختصاصه مانع.
reading.en: The social section, because its jurisdiction is exclusive.

reading.ar: المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة، بعد تنصيبها، لأن النزاع من منازعات الإفلاس.
reading.en: The specialised commercial court, once installed, because the dispute is a bankruptcy dispute.

protectiveReading.ar: اقتراح القسم الاجتماعي، والسؤال عن موضوع المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة والتنبيه إذا أجاب المحامي بنعم.
protectiveReading.en: Propose the social section, ask about the specialised commercial court's subjects, and warn if the lawyer answers yes.

question.ar: أي قسم ينظر في قسمة التركة: القسم العقاري أم قسم شؤون الأسرة؟
question.en: Which section hears the partition of an estate: the real-estate section or the family section?

why.ar: المادة 512 تذكر القسمة بين ما ينظر فيه القسم العقاري، والمادتان 498 و499 تردان في الفصل الخاص بقسم شؤون الأسرة تحت عنوان التركة دون أن تسميا القسم الذي ينظر في دعاوى التركة.
why.en: Article 512 lists partition among the real-estate section's matters; articles 498 and 499 sit in the family-section chapter under the heading 'estates' without naming the section that hears estate claims.

reading.ar: القسم العقاري، لأن المادة 512 تذكر القسمة صراحة.
reading.en: The real-estate section, because article 512 names partition expressly.

reading.ar: قسم شؤون الأسرة، لأن دعاوى التركة واردة في فصله.
reading.en: The family section, because estate claims are placed in its chapter.

protectiveReading.ar: اقتراح القسم العقاري، والسؤال عما إذا كانت القسمة قسمة تركة، والتنبيه بالقراءتين إذا كانت كذلك.
protectiveReading.en: Propose the real-estate section, ask whether the partition is of an estate, and warn with both readings if it is.

checklist.item: Basis of the claim: Law 90-11 on labour relations, the worker's right to a regular wage for work done (wage articles, payment at each due date, components of the wage, overtime, bonuses and allowances), read with the employment contract and any collective agreement.
checklist.note: Articles 80 and 88 of Law 90-11 are in the store; the articles on the components of the wage are not (k65, o1).

checklist.item: Element 1: an employment relationship with the defendant (written or unwritten contract; Law 90-11 allows proof of the relationship by any means), its start date, the post and the agreed wage.
checklist.note: Law 90-11 article 10 (proof of the contract or relationship by any means) and article 8 ¶2 were read by the verifier in OJ 1990 no. 17, page 564; they are not in the store yet (requested; o8, grade D). e1 rests on articles 2 and 80 of Law 90-11 and Civil Code 323; its proof note offers any means, witnesses included, and Civil Code 333 is kept only as an interpretive statement.

checklist.item: Element 2: work actually performed (or time at the employer's disposal) for the period claimed; wages are the counterpart of work, so periods of unpaid absence are excluded.
Element 3: non-payment by the employer of the sums claimed (base wage, overtime, bonuses, allowances), with the period and the amount of each item.

Burden of proof: the worker proves the relationship and the work; the employer, as debtor, proves payment (civil code rule that the creditor proves the obligation and the debtor proves release); payslips and the payroll register are the employer's documents.
checklist.note: The payroll register article is not in the store (k56).

checklist.item: Payslip: the employer must deliver a payslip with each payment; ask whether payslips exist and what they show; a signed payslip without reservation may be argued as proof of payment.
checklist.note: Searched labour-relations in the store (only articles 1, 2, 3, 73 to 73-4, 80 and 88 exist) and labour-disputes (article 21 names payslips only in a claim decided at first and last instance). The payslip article of Law 90-11 is requested by both derivations. Law 90-11 article 86 (the amount of the wage and all its items listed in the periodic payslip; not for expense refunds) and article 148 (penalty for paying without a payslip, page 575) are not in the store. The verifier read it in OJ 1990 no. 17 (pages 569 and 570) and requested it; it cannot be cited until the store holds it (o1, grade D).

checklist.item: Overtime: check it was ordered or accepted by the employer, the legal limits, and the rate of increase set by Law 90-11 and the collective agreement.
checklist.note: No article on overtime in the store (labour-relations holds no working-time chapter). Requested by derivation A.

checklist.item: Prior step: mandatory conciliation before the labour inspectorate's conciliation office (Law 90-04 on individual labour disputes) before any claim to the social section; the petition must attach the record of non-conciliation.
Before conciliation: the internal procedure inside the employer (collective agreement procedure or referral to the superior and management) under Law 90-04; check whether it was used.

Exceptions to conciliation: Law 90-04 lists cases where conciliation is not required (for example the employer residing abroad, or the employer in judicial settlement or bankruptcy); check which apply.

Partial conciliation: if a conciliation record settled part of the dispute, that part is enforced by the president of the social section (enforcement order), not claimed anew; only the remainder is sued on.

Time limit to file after non-conciliation: CPCM provides that the claim is filed within six months of the delivery of the record of non-conciliation, on pain of forfeiture; check the delivery date, count the six months, and whether the forfeiture is raised by the court.
checklist.note: CPCA 504 ¶1; counted under CPCA 405 with two readings of the last day kept by the module; who raises it is kept unclear by the module except for the earlier-record case (d3).

checklist.item: Limitation of wage claims: the civil code sets a short limitation for workers' wages (I recall one year for wages of workers and servants, with the creditor's oath available to the debtor), and a five-year limitation for periodic renewable rights; to be confirmed in the text.
checklist.note: Civil Code 312 ¶3 (one year; the oath of ¶4 is on whoever relies on it) and 309 ¶1 (five years for salaries and wages) both read on wages; the module keeps both. Civil Code 313 ¶2 (fifteen years where an instrument is drawn up for a right of article 309) and 319 ¶2 (fifteen years after a one-year debt is interrupted by the debtor's acknowledgement) are cited as b35 and b36, with document doc5 and open point o14.

checklist.item: Start of limitation: each wage instalment prescribes from its own due date; check the oldest unpaid month.
checklist.note: Civil Code 313 ¶1 starts limitation for the rights of article 309 from the completion of the services; the record asks the due date of the oldest wage (o7). Civil Code 313 ¶2 (fifteen years where an instrument is drawn up for a right of article 309) and 319 ¶2 (fifteen years after a one-year debt is interrupted by the debtor's acknowledgement) are cited as b35 and b36, with document doc5 and open point o14.

checklist.item: Interruption of limitation: by a judicial claim, an acknowledgement by the debtor; check whether referral to the conciliation office interrupts limitation (Law 90-04 or the civil code).
checklist.note: Civil Code 317 and 318 through the imported deadlines; whether seising the conciliation office interrupts limitation is an open point of the labour-prelitigation module. Civil Code 313 ¶2 (fifteen years where an instrument is drawn up for a right of article 309) and 319 ¶2 (fifteen years after a one-year debt is interrupted by the debtor's acknowledgement) are cited as b35 and b36, with document doc5 and open point o14.

checklist.item: Limitation is not raised by the court of its own motion; only on the defendant's plea.
checklist.note: Civil Code 321 ¶1, and ¶2 (it may be pleaded at any stage, even on appeal).

checklist.item: Competent section: the social section of the tribunal (CPCM articles on the social section: individual labour disputes, wages, contracts of employment, training and apprenticeship).
Composition: the social section sits with assessors (workers' and employers' representatives); check that the court has a social section, otherwise the rules on courts without sections apply.

Territorial jurisdiction: CPCM social matters: the court of the place where the contract was concluded or performed, or the plaintiff's domicile in specific cases (contract suspended or terminated by work accident or occupational disease); check whether this rule is of public order.
checklist.note: CPCA 501 and Law 90-04 article 24; the plea of territorial incompetence must come before any defence on the merits (CPCA 47, t3).

checklist.item: Exit: civil servants and contractual agents of public administrative institutions governed by the general civil service statute (Ordinance 06-03) go before the administrative court, not the social section.
checklist.note: Labour-relations 3 ¶1, CPCA 800 ¶2 and CPCA 804 ¶5 (staff disputes before the administrative court) are in the store; Ordinance 06-03 is not, and no rule rests on it.

checklist.item: Exit: a claim based on a criminal offence (for example the employer's criminal liability for non-payment) may be brought before the criminal judge as a civil party; check for a pending criminal case on the same facts.
checklist.note: Law 90-11 article 150 (OJ 1990 no. 17, page 575) makes non-payment of the wage when due an offence; it is not in the store yet (o4, grade D). The imported exit asks about a criminal case on the same facts.

checklist.item: Exit: an order to pay (CPCM) might be considered for a fixed written debt, but the labour conciliation rule and social section specificity apply; check whether an order to pay was already issued.
checklist.note: The module's order-to-pay exit reads a 'payment' request only, so it is not imported; whether a worker may use it for wages is open point o5.

checklist.item: Accessory request: damages for delay in payment (civil code: damages for delay require a formal notice, except listed cases; interest between individuals prohibited); check the formal notice.
checklist.note: The interest prohibition was not needed: no request for interest is proposed.

checklist.item: Accessory request: provisional execution: Law 90-04 gives provisional execution by right to judgments on payment of wages and allowances for the last six months; CPCM provisional execution rules for the rest.
checklist.note: Law 90-04 article 22, paragraphs 4 and 5.

checklist.item: Judgment in first and last resort: Law 90-04 lists matters judged without appeal (for example issuing payslips or work certificates); wage claims generally are subject to appeal.
Wage preference: wages are a privileged debt ranking before other creditors (Law 90-11 and civil code privilege); relevant if the employer is insolvent or in bankruptcy.
checklist.note: Searched labour-relations (no article on the priority of wages) and the Civil Code privileges chapter by the words الأجور and العمال; only article 565 (contractor's workers, ¶2 a privilege on sums seized) was found. Requested by both derivations. Law 90-11 article 89 («تمنح الافضلية لدفع الاجور وتسبيقاتها على جميع الديون الأخرى بما فيها ديون الخزينة والضمان الاجتماعي») is not in the store. The verifier read it in OJ 1990 no. 17 (pages 569 and 570) and requested it; it cannot be cited until the store holds it (o1, grade D).

checklist.item: Employer in bankruptcy or judicial settlement: the claim must be declared in the collective procedure; check the specialised commercial court and the suspension of individual actions.
checklist.note: The Commercial Code articles on the suspension of individual actions and the declaration of claims are not in the store. The imported exit only warns; it does not move the proposed section, which stays social (CPCA 500 ¶1 and ¶3; Law 90-04 19 ¶2 makes conciliation optional for this employer). Law 90-11 article 89 (priority of wages, OJ 1990 no. 17, page 570) is requested. Open point o12, grade D.

checklist.item: Minimum wage (SNMG): if the agreed wage is below the national guaranteed minimum wage, the difference may be claimed; check the applicable decree.
checklist.note: No article on the guaranteed minimum wage in labour-relations in the store; the decree is not in the store. Law 90-11 article 87 was amended, and article 87 مكرر repealed, by Law 14-10 (Finance Law for 2015) articles 89 and 90, read by the verifier in OJ 2014 no. 78, page 32; requested. Open point o16, grade D.

checklist.item: Documents: record of non-conciliation, employment contract or proof of relationship, payslips, social-security affiliation, statement of sums claimed month by month, formal notice if any.
checklist.note: Social-security affiliation rests on no text in the store and is not listed.

checklist.item: Petition formal elements: CPCM mandatory elements of the petition, identity of the employer (natural or legal person, its representative), fees.
checklist.note: The petition-formal-elements module has no final record to import; the claim keeps the statements of CPCA 14 ¶1 and 15 ¶1 to ¶7 (¶5 names the legal person and its representative), with CPCA 503 and 17 imported from labour-prelitigation.

checklist.item: Boundaries: dismissal compensation, abusive dismissal damages, end-of-service or redundancy compensation, and social-security benefits (social security disputes go to the social section under a different procedure with prior internal appeal) are distinct claims.
checklist.note: Redundancy compensation texts are not in the store.

checklist.item: Boundary: wages of a domestic worker or a contract that is in truth a service or agency contract (civil code) rather than employment; check subordination.

Amendments: Law 90-04 amended in 1991; Law 90-11 amended several times (1991, 1996 ordinance, 1997 ordinance); CPCM Law 08-09 amended by Law 22-13 (specialised commercial courts); check current versions.
checklist.note: The store gives articles 80 and 88 of Law 90-11 in their 1990 wording and 73-4 in the wording of ordinance 96-21; the articles of Law 90-04 in their 1990 wording, with the amendment ledger not covering them (the labour-prelitigation module keeps this open); Law 22-13 is applied through the imported exits (k67, k68, k66).

checklist.item: Is the plaintiff an employee bound to the defendant by an employment relationship (written or not), and is the defendant the employer?
What is the exact nature of each sum claimed: wage, bonus, allowance, overtime, paid leave, end-of-service entitlements?
checklist.note: The definition of the wage and its items (Law 90-11, article 81) and the refund of expenses (article 83) are not in the store. The verifier read it in OJ 1990 no. 17 (pages 569 and 570) and requested it; it cannot be cited until the store holds it (o1, grade D). Element e2 now asks for each item apart, expense refunds stated separately.

checklist.item: What is the amount owed for each period, and what proof exists (contract, payslips, attendance, witnesses)?
Has the employee exhausted the internal procedure of the employer (collective agreement, hierarchy) where it applies?
Was the matter brought before the conciliation office of the labour inspectorate, and was a record of non-conciliation delivered?
Is there a record of conciliation (agreement on part of the dispute) that limits what may still be claimed?
By what date must the claim be filed after the record of non-conciliation, and what is the sanction for filing late?
Is the claim filed before the social section of the court, and what if the court has no such section?
Which court has territorial jurisdiction: place of the work, place of the contract, or the employer's seat?
Is the dispute one for the ordinary courts, or does it escape them (public employer under statute, administrative decision)?
Is the employer a public administrative body, so that the administrative judge may be the one to hear it?
What limitation period applies to wages and related claims, from what date does it run, and how is it counted?
Does the limitation run during the employment relationship, and what interrupts or suspends it?
checklist.note: The imported deadline messages list the interrupting and suspending events (Civil Code articles 316 to 319); whether limitation runs during the relationship turns on the starting event, open point o7. Civil Code 313 ¶2 (fifteen years where an instrument is drawn up for a right of article 309) and 319 ¶2 (fifteen years after a one-year debt is interrupted by the debtor's acknowledgement) are cited as b35 and b36, with document doc5 and open point o14.

checklist.item: Who may raise limitation, and may the court raise it of its own motion?
Is a formal notice required before claiming damages for delay, and in what form?
Are damages for late payment claimable, on what conditions, and with what proof of harm?
Is interest or a penalty payment claimable on wages, and from what date?
checklist.note: No statutory interest on wages was found in the store; damages for delay on a fixed sum are Civil Code 186 (o2). The penalty payment is kept as an accessory request with a stated doubt (o9).

checklist.item: May provisional execution be requested for wages, and on what conditions?
Is the employee exempt from court fees for this claim?
checklist.note: Legal aid as of right below twice the guaranteed minimum wage (Law 90-04, 25 ¶1) and the exemption of a legal-aid beneficiary from court costs (CPCA 417 ¶2) are in the store; a general fee exemption of every labour claim was not found.

checklist.item: What must the petition contain: court, parties, facts, claims, and the documents attached?
Who bears the burden of proving the relationship, the work done, and the payment of wages?
May the employee prove the relationship and the wages by all means, or is writing required?
checklist.note: Law 90-11 article 10 is not in the store; searched labour-relations, which holds articles 1, 2, 3, 73 to 73-4, 80 and 88. The verifier read it in OJ 1990 no. 17, page 564 («يمكن اثبات عقد العمل أو علاقته بأية وسيلة كانت») and requested it; until the store holds it, o8 stays grade D and the record tells the lawyer the published text allows any means.

checklist.item: Is the employer required to keep pay records, and may their absence be used against him?
checklist.note: The pay slip duty (Law 90-11, article 86 by derivation B's reading of the French edition) and the payroll register are not in the store; requested by derivation B. Article 86 is not in the store. The verifier read it in OJ 1990 no. 17 (pages 569 and 570) and requested it; it cannot be cited until the store holds it (o1, grade D).

checklist.item: Are the claimed wages protected against deduction or set-off, and what part may the employer withhold?
checklist.note: Law 90-11 articles 89 and 90 (priority of wages; no opposition, seizure or deduction of wages owed, for any reason) are not in the store. The verifier read it in OJ 1990 no. 17 (pages 569 and 570) and requested it; it cannot be cited until the store holds it (o1, grade D). An employer's deduction or set-off defence is answered in o1 only.

checklist.item: Does a payment or a receipt signed by the employee settle the claim, and what is its force?
checklist.note: Only the general rule that the debtor proves his release was found; no text on receipts for wages in the store.

checklist.item: Does the claim also involve a dismissal or termination that should be pleaded separately?
Is a request for a certificate of work or a pay statement to be added as an accessory request?
Are the costs and lawyer fees claimable, and under which text?
Is a lawyer mandatory in this court for this kind of claim?
checklist.note: Representation by a lawyer is compulsory only before the courts of appeal and cassation (CPCA 10 ¶1); the first-instance petition may be lodged by the plaintiff, his agent or his lawyer (CPCA 14 ¶1).

checklist.item: Does the plaintiff have the status to sue (capacity, standing), and is a representative such as a union able to act?
checklist.note: A union's capacity to act for an individual worker was not found in the store.

checklist.item: Penal provisions of Law 90-11 on the non-payment of wages.
checklist.note: Not in the store (labour-relations holds no penal chapter). The verifier read Law 90-11 articles 148, 149, 150 and 155 in OJ 1990 no. 17, page 575 (article 150: a fine for each breach of the duty to pay the wage when due) and requested them; o4, grade D.

checklist.item: The articles of Law 90-11 around article 80 and article 88 (the definition and items of the wage, its payment, and the articles that follow).
checklist.note: Articles 79, 81 to 87 and 89 of Law 90-11 are not in the store. The verifier read it in OJ 1990 no. 17 (pages 569 and 570) and requested it; it cannot be cited until the store holds it (o1, grade D).

checklist.item: What does the store's note on CPCA article 32 (Law 22-13, temporal boundary of the new jurisdiction rules) raise for the section rule?
checklist.note: The note concerns the new subject-matter and territorial rules for the specialised commercial and administrative courts. Paragraphs 4, 5 and 6 of article 32 (listing by the nature of the dispute, courts without sections, referral to the right section), on which the section rule and exit court-sections.x3 rest, read the same in the law-08-09 and law-22-13 versions in the store.

checklist.item: What does the store's note on CPCA article 800 (Law 22-13, temporal boundary) raise for this claim?
checklist.note: The law-22-13 wording of 800 ¶2 adds national public bodies and national professional organisations, and ¶1 excepts disputes given to other courts; Law 22-13 runs its new administrative-jurisdiction rules from the installation of the new courts, a date the store does not record. For the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body both wordings agree (labour-prelitigation.x1); the national-public-body exit (court-sections.x4) rests on the new wording only and is interpretive, so it warns. Added by the reconciler: both derivations cite 800 through court-sections.b47.

checklist.item: What does the store's note on CPCA article 804 (Law 22-13, temporal boundary) raise for the exit of a civil servant's claim?
checklist.note: 804 ¶5 sends disputes on civil servants and staff of public administrative bodies to the administrative courts in both versions; the versions differ only on the court's place (the place of appointment in law-08-09, the place where the duties are exercised in law-22-13), a territorial matter. The exit warns either way. Added by the reconciler: derivation A imports the exit that cites 804.

checklist.item: What does the store's note on Civil Code article 565 (current-snapshot note of the corpus report) raise for this claim?
checklist.note: The note names no amendment and no date from which another wording applies; it says the text is a snapshot at the corpus cut-off. The paragraph serves only a note-only boundary (n3) that produces no finding, so nothing in this unit turns on a commencement date. Added by the reconciler.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag f-b10-p2: Civil Code 333 ¶2 (value assessed when the act was made; witnesses allowed when the excess comes only from accessories).
checklist.note: Paragraph 2 only measures the value threshold of paragraph 1. The record draws no rule from that threshold: whether article 333 reaches the employment relationship at all is open point o8 (grade D), and no amount is compared.

checklist.item: What does the store's note on CPCA article 536 مكرر (Law 22-13, temporal boundary) raise for the exit of an employer in bankruptcy or judicial settlement?
checklist.note: Article 536 مكرر exists only in the law-22-13 wording, whose jurisdiction rules run from the installation of the specialised commercial courts, a date the store does not record. The imported exit is interpretive and only warns; the conciliation exemption for an employer in bankruptcy or settlement (Law 90-04, 19 ¶2) does not depend on it. Added by the reconciler: both derivations import the exit.

checklist.item: What does the store's note on Civil Code article 3 (amendment chain not certified) raise for the counting of the wage limitation periods?
checklist.note: The note names no amendment and no date from which another wording applies; the calendar counting it supports is kept by the periods module with the other reading (a fixed count of days) and a band widened for leap days, and both deadlines only warn. Added by the reconciler.

checklist.item: What do the store's notes on Civil Code articles 106, 119 and 120 (current-snapshot notes) raise for the imported notice boundaries?
checklist.note: The notes name no amendment and no commencement date; they say the texts are snapshots at the corpus cut-off. The boundaries resting on them only warn. Added by the reconciler.

checklist.item: What does the store's note on Civil Code article 133 (current-snapshot note) raise for the imported document on the start of a period?
checklist.note: Article 133 (the harmful act) is one of three starts the document names; a wage claim uses the due date and the delivery of the non-conciliation record. The note names no amendment and no commencement date. Added by the reconciler.

checklist.item: Does the worker belong to a category for which Law 90-11 article 4 lets regulations set a special regime of the working relationship (company managers, air and sea navigation staff, merchant ship and fishing crews, home workers, journalists, artists and actors, commercial representatives, elite athletes, domestic staff)?
checklist.note: Law 90-11 article 4 is not in the store (labour-relations holds articles 1, 2, 3, 73 to 73-4, 80 and 88). The verifier read it in OJ 1990 no. 17, page 563, and requested it; open point o15, grade D.

message.ar: المادة 504 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: ترفع الدعوى أمام القسم الاجتماعي في أجل لا يتجاوز ستة (6) أشهر من تاريخ تسليم محضر عدم الصلح تحت طائلة سقوط الحق في رفع الدعوى. وهذا الأجل منصوص عليه في هذا القانون فتسري عليه المادة 405: يمدد إلى أول يوم عمل إذا لم يكن آخره يوم عمل (الفقرتان 3 و4)؛ ولا يقرر القانون 90-04 المتعلق بتسوية النزاعات الفردية في العمل أجلا آخر لرفع الدعوى (المادة 36 منه). وفي آخر يوم قراءتان: (1) يحسب الأجل كاملا فلا يحسب يوم التسليم ولا يوم انقضاء الأجل، فتقبل الدعوى في اليوم الموالي لتمام الستة أشهر (المادة 405 الفقرة 1)، وهي القراءة المعتمدة؛ (2) يحسب يوم التسليم لأنه ليس يوم تبليغ ولا تبليغ رسمي، فينتهي الأجل في اليوم المقابل ليوم التسليم، أي قبل ذلك بيوم (المادة 504 والمادة 405 الفقرة 1، نقطة مفتوحة). الأحوط رفع الدعوى قبل انقضاء الأجل في القراءة الثانية. لا يمنع التصدير النظيف إلا بعد انقضاء الأجل في القراءة التي تنتهي متأخرة وانقضاء هامشه، وينبه قبل ذلك. وإذا لم يوجد في الشهر الأخير اليوم المقابل ليوم التسليم فنهاية الأجل محل قراءتين (نقطة مفتوحة). ويرفع السقوط في حالة القوة القاهرة بأمر من رئيس الجهة القضائية (المادة 322). تحقق من تاريخ تسليم المحضر.
message.en: CPCA, article 504: the claim must be brought before the social section within six (6) months of the delivery of the non-conciliation record, or the right to bring it is forfeited. The period is laid down in this Code, so article 405 governs it: it runs to the next working day when its last day is not one (paragraphs 3 and 4); Law 90-04 on individual labour disputes sets no other period for bringing the claim (its article 36). Two readings exist on the last day: (1) the period is counted in full, neither the day of delivery nor the day it expires counts, so the claim may still be filed on the day after the six months end (article 405, paragraph 1), the reading the record holds; (2) the day of delivery counts, since it is not a day of notification or service, and the period ends on the day matching the day of delivery, one day earlier (article 504 and article 405, paragraph 1; open point). The safe course is to file before the period ends under the second reading. The clean export is blocked only after the later of the two last days and its band have passed; before that the item warns. Where the last month has no day matching the day of delivery, where the period ends is kept with two readings (open point). A forfeiture for force majeure is lifted by the president's order (article 322). Check the date the record was delivered.

message.ar: المادة 504 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: ترفع الدعوى أمام القسم الاجتماعي في أجل لا يتجاوز ستة (6) أشهر من تاريخ تسليم محضر عدم الصلح تحت طائلة سقوط الحق، ويستثنى من السقوط حالة القوة القاهرة أو الأحداث المؤثرة في السير العادي لمرفق العدالة، ويقدم طلب رفع السقوط إلى رئيس الجهة القضائية المعروض أمامها النزاع ويفصل فيه بأمر على عريضة (المادة 322). ويحسب الأجل وفق المادة 405 لأنه منصوص عليه في هذا القانون، ويمدد إلى أول يوم عمل (الفقرتان 3 و4)، ولا يقرر القانون 90-04 أجلا آخر (المادة 36 منه). وفي آخر يوم قراءتان: لا يحسب يوم التسليم ولا يوم انقضاء الأجل (المادة 405 الفقرة 1، القراءة المعتمدة)، أو يحسب يوم التسليم لأنه ليس يوم تبليغ فينتهي الأجل قبل ذلك بيوم (المادة 504 والمادة 405 الفقرة 1، نقطة مفتوحة). تحقق من تاريخ تسليم المحضر ومن إثبات القوة القاهرة ومن تقديم طلب رفع السقوط.
message.en: CPCA, article 504: the claim must be brought before the social section within six (6) months of the delivery of the non-conciliation record, on pain of forfeiture; force majeure and events affecting the normal working of the courts are excepted, and the request to lift the forfeiture goes to the president of the court before which the dispute is brought, who rules by an order on petition (article 322). The period is laid down in this Code and counted under article 405, running to the next working day (paragraphs 3 and 4); Law 90-04 sets no other period (its article 36). Two readings exist on the last day: neither the day of delivery nor the day the period expires counts (article 405, paragraph 1; the reading the record holds), or the day of delivery counts, since it is not a day of notification, and the period ends one day earlier (article 504 and article 405, paragraph 1; open point). Check the delivery date, the proof of the force majeure, and that the request to lift the forfeiture is made.

message.ar: المادة 504 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: ترفع الدعوى أمام القسم الاجتماعي في أجل لا يتجاوز ستة (6) أشهر من تاريخ تسليم محضر عدم الصلح تحت طائلة سقوط الحق في رفع الدعوى. وقضت المحكمة العليا (الغرفة الاجتماعية، الملف 1488919) بأن الحق يسقط إذا أصبح محضر عدم الصلح الأول خارج أجل ستة أشهر، وأنه لا يمكن استصدار محضر ثان بعدم الصلح بخصوص نفس النزاع، وأن عدم القبول في هذه الحالة من النظام العام يثيره القاضي تلقائيا (المادة 69). ويحسب الأجل وفق المادة 405 ويمدد إلى أول يوم عمل (الفقرتان 3 و4)؛ وفي آخر يوم قراءتان: لا يحسب يوم التسليم ولا يوم انقضاء الأجل (المادة 405 الفقرة 1، القراءة المعتمدة)، أو يحسب يوم التسليم لأنه ليس يوم تبليغ فينتهي الأجل قبل ذلك بيوم (المادة 504 والمادة 405 الفقرة 1، نقطة مفتوحة). تحقق من تاريخ تسليم المحضر الأول.
message.en: CPCA, article 504: the claim must be brought before the social section within six (6) months of the delivery of the non-conciliation record, or the right to bring it is forfeited. The Supreme Court (social chamber, file 1488919) held that the right is forfeited once the first non-conciliation record is outside the six months, that a second record cannot be obtained on the same dispute, and that this inadmissibility is of public order, raised by the judge of his own motion (article 69). The period is counted under article 405 and runs to the next working day (paragraphs 3 and 4); two readings exist on the last day: neither the day of delivery nor the day the period expires counts (article 405, paragraph 1; the reading the record holds), or the day of delivery counts, since it is not a day of notification, and the period ends one day earlier (article 504 and article 405, paragraph 1; open point). Check the delivery date of the first record.

deadlines.interpretiveNote: Article 504 ¶1 runs the period from «تسليم محضر عدم الصلح» and says nothing of a second record. Counting from the first record rests on the Supreme Court's social chamber (file 1488919, 07-10-2021, read on coursupreme.dz): «يسقط حق العامل في رفع دعواه أمام القسم الاجتماعي، إذا أصبح محضر عدم الصلح الأول خارج أجل ستة أشهر» and «لا يمكن استصدار محضر ثان بعدم الصلح بخصوص نفس النزاع الذي تضمنه المحضر الأول». Case law, so the deadline is interpretive and warns. The last day carries the same two countings as d1 (open point o15).

reading.ar: يحسب الأجل من تسليم المحضر الأول، ولا يفتح المحضر الثاني أجلا جديدا (المحكمة العليا، الملف 1488919).
reading.en: The period runs from the delivery of the first record; a second record does not open a new period (Supreme Court, file 1488919).

reading.ar: يحسب الأجل من تسليم محضر عدم الصلح المرفق بالعريضة، لأن النص لا يميز بين محضر أول وثان.
reading.en: The period runs from the delivery of the record attached to the petition, the text not distinguishing a first from a second record.

message.ar: المادة 312 من القانون المدني: تتقادم بسنة واحدة (1) المبالغ المستحقة للعمال مقابل عملهم، ومن يتمسك بهذا التقادم يحلف أنه أدى الدين، ولا تقضي به المحكمة تلقائيا (المادة 321). تحقق من تاريخ استحقاق كل أجر مطالب به ومن كل سبب قاطع للتقادم (المواد 317 و318 و319) أو موقف له، كمانع يمنع الدائن من المطالبة أو عدم أهليته أو غيابه أو الحكم عليه بعقوبة جنائية دون نائب قانوني (المادة 316)، ومن تحرير سند بالحق (المادة 313، محل قراءتين). مدة الأجور محل قراءتين محفوظتين. وطريقة حساب السنوات، وامتداد المدة إذا انتهت في يوم عطلة، وأثر الإعذار أو الرسالة في قطعها، محل قراءات محفوظة (نقاط مفتوحة).
message.en: Civil Code, article 312: sums owed to workers for their work are time-barred after 1 year; whoever relies on it must swear that he paid, and the court does not apply it of its own motion (article 321). Check the due date of each wage claimed, any act that interrupted the period (articles 317, 318, 319) and anything that suspended it, such as an impediment that kept the creditor from claiming or his incapacity, absence or criminal sentence without a legal representative (article 316), and whether a written instrument was drawn up for the right (article 313, two readings kept). The period for wages is kept with two readings. How the years are counted, whether the period runs on when it ends on a holiday, and whether a formal notice or a letter interrupts it are kept with their readings (open points).

deadlines.interpretiveNote: The Civil Code gives two periods that both read on wage arrears: one year for sums owed to workers for their work, and five years for periodic rights including wages. The texts do not say which prevails; the record warns from the shorter one, and d4 warns at five years under both readings. Three more readings are kept open on the owner's instruction (verifier, follow-up 1, boundary cases bc5, bc9 to bc12): how a year is counted (open point o15), whether a period ending on a non-working day, such as a Friday or an official holiday, runs to the next working day (o16), and whether a bailiff's formal notice or a registered letter interrupts it (o8). The rule keeps the earlier last day of each (calendar counting with a band widened by one leap day, no extension, no interruption by a notice or letter), so the item warns under every reading near the last day.

reading.ar: يسري على الأجور التقادم بسنة لأنه نص خاص بأجور العمال، وهو قائم على قرينة الوفاء بدليل يمين المدين.
reading.en: Wages are subject to the one-year limitation, a specific rule for workers' pay resting on a presumption of payment, as the debtor's oath shows.

reading.ar: يسري على الأجور التقادم بخمس سنوات لأنها حقوق دورية متجددة ذكرت صراحة، ولا يسري التقادم بسنة إلا على غير الأجور الدورية.
reading.en: Wages are subject to the five-year limitation, being periodic rights named expressly; the one-year limitation reaches only non-periodic pay.

message.ar: المادة 309 من القانون المدني: تتقادم المرتبات والأجور بخمس (5) سنوات ولو أقر بها المدين، ولا تقضي به المحكمة تلقائيا (المادة 321). تحقق من تاريخ استحقاق كل أجر مطالب به؛ وما استحق قبل خمس سنوات من رفع الدعوى معرض للدفع بالتقادم. وتحقق من تحرير سند بالحق (المادة 313، محل قراءتين). وطريقة حساب السنوات، وامتداد المدة إذا انتهت في يوم عطلة، وأثر الإعذار أو الرسالة في قطعها، محل قراءات محفوظة (نقاط مفتوحة).
message.en: Civil Code, article 309: salaries and wages are time-barred after 5 years, even if the debtor acknowledged them, and the court does not apply it of its own motion (article 321). Check the due date of each wage claimed; wages that fell due more than five years before filing are exposed to a limitation plea. Check also whether a written instrument was drawn up for the right (article 313, two readings kept). How the years are counted, whether the period runs on when it ends on a holiday, and whether a formal notice or a letter interrupts it are kept with their readings (open points).

deadlines.interpretiveNote: Kept open on the owner's instruction (verifier, follow-up 1, boundary cases bc5, bc6, bc7). How five years are counted across a leap day: by the Gregorian calendar (civil-code 3 ¶1), so five years from 28 February end on 28 February, or as a fixed number of days (314 ¶1 'بالايام لا بالساعات'), which ends a day or two earlier (open point o15). Whether a period ending on a non-working day runs on (o16), and whether a formal notice or a letter interrupts it (o8), are kept the same way. Which deadline carries the five years of 309 ¶1 for wages: this one, read from the date of the oldest wage, while the deadline on other periodic rights (d8) stays silent in a wage claim; the boundary cases read 309 ¶1 as one deadline for every periodic right; the period and its start are the same under both, and whether one year or five governs wages is o1. The rule keeps calendar counting with a band widened by the two leap days five years can hold, so a fixed count of days also warns.

reading.ar: تحسب السنوات الخمس بالتقويم الميلادي من يوم الاستحقاق إلى مثله، ويحمل هذا الأجل مدة الأجور وحدها.
reading.en: The five years are counted by the calendar from the due date to the same day, and this deadline alone carries the period for wages.

reading.ar: تحسب السنوات الخمس بعدد ثابت من الأيام دون اعتبار اليوم الكبيس، وتسري مدة الحقوق الدورية المتجددة على الأجور بالأجل نفسه الذي يسري على غيرها.
reading.en: The five years are a fixed number of days, leap days left out, and the period of periodic renewable rights reaches wages through the same deadline as the other periodic rights.

message.ar: المادتان 19 و37 من قانون تسوية النزاعات الفردية في العمل: يجب أن يكون كل خلاف فردي في العمل موضوع محاولة صلح أمام مكتب المصالحة قبل مباشرة أي دعوى قضائية، وترفق العريضة بنسخة من محضر عدم المصالحة. وقضت المحكمة العليا (الغرفة الاجتماعية، الملفان 1158046 و1340230) بأنه لا تقبل الدعوى أمام القسم الاجتماعي في غياب محضر عدم مصالحة، وأثارت ذلك تلقائيا. تحقق من وجود المحضر ومن تاريخ تسليمه السابق لتاريخ العريضة، أو من قيام إحدى حالات الإعفاء.
message.en: Articles 19 and 37 of the law on individual labour disputes: every individual labour dispute must go through a conciliation attempt before the conciliation office before any court action, and the petition is accompanied by a copy of the non-conciliation record. The Supreme Court (social chamber, files 1158046 and 1340230) held that a claim before the social section is not admissible without a non-conciliation record, and raised the point of its own motion. Check that the record exists and was delivered before the petition's date, or that an exemption applies.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Article 19 states the duty and article 37 requires the copy of the record; neither states the sanction of a petition filed without it. The Supreme Court's social chamber supplies it: «لا تقبل الدعوى أمام القسم الإجتماعي في غياب محضر عدم مصالحة» (file 1158046, 07-09-2017), raised of its own motion as «مخالفة قاعدة جوهرية في الإجراءات», and again in file 1340230 (05-03-2020) on articles 19, 36 and 37. That is case law, so the step stays interpretive: it warns, naming the inadmissibility, and never blocks. The step counts as done only when the record exists and was delivered before the petition's date (19 ¶1: before any court action): with the delivery date unknown the step asks for it, and with a delivery on or after the petition's date the step leaves the answer to boundary n5.

message.ar: المواد 2 و4 و5 من قانون تسوية النزاعات الفردية في العمل: النزاع الفردي خلاف لم يحل في إطار التسوية الداخلية، ولا يخطر العامل مفتش العمل إلا بعد استنفاد إجراءات المعالجة الداخلية. تحقق من استنفاد هذه الإجراءات إذا كان المدعي هو العامل.
message.en: Articles 2, 4 and 5 of the law on individual labour disputes: an individual dispute is one not resolved by internal settlement, and the worker refers it to the labour inspector after the internal procedure is exhausted. When the worker is the plaintiff, check that this procedure was followed.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: The texts put the internal procedure before the referral to the labour inspector; they state no consequence for a court claim filed when it was skipped, and they speak only of the worker. Warn; never block.

label.en: Notice by post in the way the code provides (the text that sets out that way was not found; open point o2)
An act that stands in the place of a warning

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Article 179 says compensation is not due before notice and states no sanction on the claim; whether the petition or its service counts as an act that stands in the place of a warning (article 180), whether a notice served after filing suffices, and whether the lack of notice makes the request inadmissible or only unfounded, are readings. A reading never blocks: warn. The step counts as done only when the notice was served by a bailiff (means m1, and m2 whose warning a bailiff serves) and before the petition's day (owner's decision of 14 November 2026; article 180 «بانذاره», and «بعد اعذار» in articles 179, 119 and 164). A notice by post (m3, n11) or by another act (m4, n1), or one whose means or date before the petition is unknown (n1, n11, n12), leaves the step open: the rule language has no condition on 'done', so requiredWhen carries it. The step then asks for the unknown fact, or, when the means or the date is known and not of that kind, gives no finding of its own and leaves the warning to n1, n11 or n12.

message.ar: المادة 179 من القانون المدني: لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد إعذار المدين، ما لم يوجد نص مخالف أو حالة من حالات المادة 181. تحقق من الإعذار ووسيلته وتاريخه وأنه سابق على العريضة، أو من حالة الإعفاء.
message.en: Civil Code article 179: compensation is due only after the debtor is put on notice, unless a text provides otherwise or a case of article 181 applies. Check the notice, its means and its date (before the petition), or the exemption.
